properties.markdownProperty:
Alphabetically ordered list of the specific terms of the problem domain whose meaning must be clarified, each one with its definition. It can be accompanied by multimedia material (photographs, scanned documents, diagrams...).
Recommended archetypes: **Glossary item**. PROTEUS automatically highlights and links the glossary terms when they appear in the text of other elements. Acronyms and abbreviations go in the *Glossary of acronyms and abbreviations* appendix.
